text: もってる　ポケモンが　よわって　きて　たたかわせたく　ない　ときは　くさむらを　よけて　かえろう！

structure.jp: もってる　ポケモンが　よわって　きて
structure.en: the Pokémon you have are getting weak, and

structure.jp: たたかわせたく　ない　ときは
structure.en: when you don't want to make them battle

structure.jp: くさむらを　よけて　かえろう！
structure.en: avoid the tall grass and head back!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-verb says a change has been building up until now. よわって きて = 'have been getting weaker, and'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: たたかわせたく　ない
patterns.explanation: The せ in たたかわせる means 'make someone do it', and たく ない adds 'don't want to'. たたかわせたく ない = 'don't want to make them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending means 'let's do it', here as friendly advice. よけて かえろう = 'let's avoid it and go home'.
